changelog: Full catalog pages now include 30 TMDB pages plus the complete Movibox library
Movies tab now includes all Movibox movies with direct HD playback
Series tab now includes all Movibox series
Popular franchise search works across TMDB and Movibox
Live TV buffering fixed at the root: live streams now start with a real buffer cushion (was 1 second) and hold 15-30s of stream — plays through WiFi jitter instead of stalling
Live video capped to 720p on Fire sticks — 1080p needs 4-5Mbps the relays can't sustain, which caused the constant rebuffer loop
Runtime stream probe: the app now tests every channel's stream on load (cached 30 min) and hides dead ones — 35 dead channels auto-purged
Source hiccups now recover in ~1.5s via live-edge resync instead of cycling through dead servers
More dead Star/Sony relays purged (mislabeled Kannada feeds, Ten 4)
TV focus system: live channel thumbnails now get a clear scale + white/gold halo on Fire TV and Android TV
Live TV rebuilt as a category rail + responsive 10/8/7-column channel wall
Focused tiles scroll into view while navigating
Search tab now focuses the search input so typed queries land immediately
Fixed duplicate live channel ids that caused rendering errors
